field_candidates.proposed_value: All 10 recipients in the most recent optimized Cohort 2 cadre, enrolled August 2020 through October 2021; not a response-defined subset.
field_candidates.limitation: Cadre chronology does not establish disjoint participants from earlier reports.

field_candidates.proposed_value: First-in-human, open-label phase 1/2 safety, tolerability and efficacy trial; interim publication of one 10-person cadre in a larger study.
field_candidates.scope: Publication cadre within the multicenter trial.
field_candidates.limitation: Not a randomized efficacy comparison or the entire registry population.

field_candidates.proposed_value: Established type 1 diabetes for at least 5 years, with hypoglycemia unawareness or significant glycemic lability.
field_candidates.limitation: Eligibility is not evidence that every participant had every listed clinical characteristic.

field_candidates.proposed_value: Entry criteria included MMTT C-peptide below 0.07 nmol/L and HbA1c at most 10%; hypoglycemia-unawareness qualification used Clarke score at least 4. Prior islet, kidney or pancreas transplantation and specified severe diabetic complications were exclusion criteria.
field_candidates.scope: Main-narrative eligibility summary, not an exhaustive protocol transcription.
field_candidates.limitation: Do not replace the observed baseline LOD threshold with the eligibility cutoff.

field_candidates.proposed_value: At screening, all 10 had basal and 90-minute MMTT plasma C-peptide below the assay detection limit of 0.03 nmol/L.
field_candidates.scope: Observed full-cadre baseline, not a reported numeric zero.
field_candidates.limitation: Below detection is distinct from absence of all endogenous secretion and from the 0.07 nmol/L entry threshold.

field_candidates.proposed_value: PEC-Direct/VC-02: PEC-01 cells derived from the CyT49 pluripotent stem cell line in perforated delivery devices implanted subcutaneously.
field_candidates.scope: Author description of the implanted combination product.
field_candidates.limitation: Not encapsulation without systemic immunosuppression.

field_candidates.proposed_value: Author-estimated contents: approximately 75 million PEC-01 cells per dose-finding unit and 7 million per sentinel; author-reported mean initial implanted cell dose 14 million cells/kg.
field_candidates.scope: Per-device estimates and author-reported cohort mean; no participant device counts used.
field_candidates.limitation: Do not calculate a common total dose, individual dose, or exposure duration from these quantities.

field_candidates.proposed_value: Publication is one 10-person optimized cadre within Cohort 2 of NCT03163511; references CR17 and CR18 describe earlier Cohort 2 groups.
locators: PMC11471599.1, Methods Sec9/Par31 and Par33; references CR17 and CR18
field_candidates.limitation: No shared participant count, same/subset/distinct relationship, or publication-to-registry outcome transfer established.

field_candidates.scope: Enrollment of this publication cadre only.
field_candidates.limitation: Not all-study enrollment or a universal endpoint-analysis denominator.

locators: PMC11471599.1, Methods Sec9/Par31 and Par33; Results Sec4/Par10
field_candidates.limitation: Not the number with evaluable data at every visit.

field_candidates.proposed_value: Anti-thymocyte globulin induction adjusted to lymphocyte counts; tacrolimus plus mycophenolate mofetil maintenance.
field_candidates.limitation: No exact maintenance duration, cumulative dose, or full regimen adherence established by this partial inspection.

field_candidates.proposed_value: Diabetes educator independent of the study team and unaware of C-peptide results guided glycemic control and insulin administration; protocol used Dexcom G6 CGM and regular medical/laboratory follow-up with immunosuppression adjustment when needed.
field_candidates.limitation: Does not isolate an implant causal effect from concomitant care.

field_candidates.proposed_value: Cell-containing devices placed subcutaneously in abdominal wall and flanks under general anesthesia two days after ATG initiation.
field_candidates.scope: Initial implantation procedure and relation to induction, not participant dates.
field_candidates.limitation: Exact calendar dates, any repeat cell administrations and their durations remain unestablished.

field_candidates.proposed_value: MMTT baseline four weeks before transplant; post-transplant testing every three months. Results label observations by post-implant month; protocol primary endpoint is baseline to week 26, with narrative reporting month 6.
locators: PMC11471599.1, Methods Sec10/Par40; Sec9/Par33; Results Sec4/Par10
field_candidates.limitation: Preserve week 26 and month 6 wording; do not assert identical visit dates, reset to a subsequent infusion, or make maximum planned follow-up actual follow-up.

field_candidates.proposed_value: Two patients reported treatment-emergent serious adverse events. Procedural pain was the most common TEAE; no TEAEs met the protocol-defined adverse-events-of-special-interest category.
field_candidates.limitation: Two is an affected-person count, not a separately enumerated total of all serious events or all TEAEs.

field_candidates.proposed_value: The Results safety narrative accompanies the full 10-person implanted optimized cadre.
field_candidates.scope: Publication target for narrative safety reporting.
field_candidates.limitation: No common observation duration or person-time denominator established.

field_candidates.proposed_value: Source attributes one affected patient's treatment-emergent serious adverse event to the surgical procedure and the other's to protocol-specified immunosuppression.
field_candidates.scope: Source-reported attribution, not an independent causal adjudication.
field_candidates.limitation: Methods Sec10/Par38 also says no adverse events during/after interventions; reconcile scope and timing before final safety adjudication, without deleting either statement.

field_candidates.proposed_value: The source states that no treatment-emergent adverse event led to study withdrawal.
field_candidates.limitation: Not zero total withdrawals, zero treatment discontinuations, complete follow-up or absence of missing visits.

aggregate_surrogate_observations.definition: MMTT-induced C-peptide above LOD 0.03 nmol/L; study protocol selects the 90-minute MMTT sample.
aggregate_surrogate_observations.denominator_basis: Explicit source aggregate count of recipients, not number with complete later visits.
locators: PMC11471599.1, Results Sec4/Par10; Results Sec3/Par8; Methods Sec10/Par40
aggregate_surrogate_observations.limitation: Reported C-peptide range 0.05-0.07 nmol/L is for detectable recipients, not a full-cohort clinical outcome. No ledger insulin-independence value proposed.

aggregate_surrogate_observations.definition: Primary implant-function endpoint: MMTT-induced C-peptide above LOD 0.03 nmol/L; 90-minute assessment.
aggregate_surrogate_observations.denominator_basis: Explicit 4 of 10 recipients in aggregate Results prose.
aggregate_surrogate_observations.nominal_timing: Post-implant month 6; protocol says baseline to week 26
locators: PMC11471599.1, Results Sec3/Par8; Sec4/Par10; Methods Sec9/Par33; Sec10/Par40
aggregate_surrogate_observations.limitation: Not a fixed month-12 result, clinical benefit numerator, insulin-independence numerator, or proof of complete visit data in all 10.

aggregate_surrogate_observations.definition: Secondary implant-function threshold: MMTT-induced C-peptide above 0.07 nmol/L sustained until month 12.
aggregate_surrogate_observations.denominator_basis: Aggregate full-cadre target of 10; three of the four primary responders reached the secondary threshold. Not an evaluable-visit count.
locators: PMC11471599.1, Results Sec4/Par10; Discussion Sec7/Par23 aggregate summary
aggregate_surrogate_observations.limitation: Reported 0.10-0.23 nmol/L range describes threshold achievers; do not impute values to others or convert the result to insulin independence or all-patient complete follow-up.

planned_protocol_endpoints.definition: Change from baseline in average insulin dose and proportion with 50% reduction.
Proportion with insulin independence is listed as a secondary protocol endpoint; a cessation/duration definition is not established by that listing.
Proportion of time in glucose bands below 54, 54 to below 70, 70 to at most 180, and above 180 mg/dL; baseline changes in hypo-, eu- and hyperglycemic time.
Frequency of hypoglycemic events and proportion free of events; do not automatically equate this with the frozen severe-hypoglycemia domain.

timing_and_method_annotations.mmtt: Boost Hi-Protein 360 mL consumed within 15 minutes; no pre-meal insulin bolus; blood every 30 minutes, with 90-minute sample selected for endpoint assessment.
timing_and_method_annotations.protocol_maximum: Up to 104 weeks for secondary protocol follow-up.
timing_and_method_annotations.actual_report_scope: Aggregate surrogate observations at months 3 and 6 and sustained secondary threshold until month 12; this is not evidence that all 10 completed 104 weeks or every 12-month measure.
timing_and_method_annotations.anchor: Post-implant/transplant terminology refers to cell-containing device implantation. Exact first-cell calendar dates and repeat-administration history not established here.
